_comment: Featured projects, in display order. Edited by hand: the production build is offline, so nothing is fetched from GitHub. Values copied from the GitHub API on 2026-11-06.

projects.description: Terminal UI to decode, tamper with, and re-sign JWTs. Real-time validity/expiry, HMAC/RSA/ECDSA/EdDSA support, built-in security analysis (alg confusion, alg:none, weak keys), and scriptable --print/--json output for CI.
Contributor. A minimal, terminal-based HTTP(S) proxy for pentesters and CTF players. Think Burp Suite or Caido, but entirely in your terminal.
Personal NUR repository packaging my security tools for Nix, starting with jwt-tui. Usable as a flake input, an overlay or through NUR.
NixOS flake for a Hyprland laptop and a self-hosted server behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, built on home-manager, Stylix, sops-nix and nvf. Fork of anotherhadi/nixy.
Source of this site: a static Astro blog for CTF writeups, security notes and projects, with Pagefind search and a Nix build.
